name: What steps does Frasheski Construction take to ensure minimal disruption during tile installation coordination?

mainEntity.name: What steps does Frasheski Construction take to ensure minimal disruption during tile installation coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure minimal disruption during tile installation coordination, Frasheski Construction focuses on meticulous planning, clear communication, and efficient site management. We establish a detailed project schedule, inform you of upcoming work phases, and maintain a clean and organized work area. Our team works to contain dust and protect surrounding areas, ensuring your daily routine is impacted as little as possible throughout the installation process in your home or business.
